steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: GCSE RS requires you to understand both the scientific theory of evolution and religious responses to it, including whether they can be compatible. | RS Exam Tips — The Origins of Human Life: 1. For The Origins of Human Life questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Origins of Human Life to its real-world impact on believers and society | UK Context: In the UK, debates about often involve both religious and secular voices.
